output:
An in-process cache skips network calls, but each worker has its own copy and may return older data than another. A shared cache lets all workers see the same data, but adds a network call and an extra service to manage.

For this read-only dashboard, delays up to 60 seconds are acceptable, so use the in-process cache for now.

Do not use this recommendation for permission checks—stale data could grant access after permission was revoked. Revisit this choice if the dashboard needs fresher data, but note that a shared cache alone still does not guarantee fresh reads.
